info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Replace Healthcare Appointments Reschedule-v4-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointments Rescheduling API enables healthcare providers to efficiently reschedule patient appointments. This endpoint allows for the updating of existing appointments, ensuring that changes to schedules are managed seamlessly. Typical consumers include healthcare administrative staff and scheduling systems that require real-time updates to appointment availability. By leveraging this API, organizations can improve patient satisfaction and optimize resource allocation within their practices.

put.description: This operation allows users to change the time or date of an existing appointment. Users must provide the appointment ID and the new desired time and date to successfully update the appointment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of an existing appointment by providing the new scheduling information. Ensure that the request includes all necessary fields as defined in the schema to successfully reschedule the appointment.

200.description: Request completed successfully with updated appointment details.
